captions.detailed: A small wooden garden bell tower with a decorative open timber frame. The structure features four vertical posts with diagonal corner braces, horizontal support beams, and an open pitched roof truss. A golden-brown bell hangs from a dark grey horizontal pivot bar across the center, allowing it to swing back and forth on a revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a small garden bell tower with a dark brown timber frame. It should have a flat rectangular base, four corner posts with diagonal supports, an open pitched roof frame, and a golden-brown bell suspended from a central pivot bar that is articulated with a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The model is built using two main parts: a fixed frame and a rotating bell assembly. The frame is constructed from multiple Box primitives representing the base, vertical corner posts, horizontal rails, diagonal braces, and roof rafters, all colored in a dark brown wood tone. The bell assembly is made of a Cylinder for the horizontal hanger shaft, a central collar, and a custom bell shape created by revolving a curved profile. A revolute joint is defined along the Y-axis of the central horizontal shaft to connect the bell to the frame.
